summary: Surveyed C:/Users/mchan/UnityProjects/ for agent transcripts/journals across ncp and its siblings, collecting file counts and sizes for .agent-journal, .gizmo/memory/journal, .pi, .claude, Claude outputs, and AGENTS.md locations. Sampled ~7 recent non-empty transcripts from ncp and cronkis gizmo journals plus an older ncp agent-journal entry, analyzing prompting quality, model mentions, skill usage, and recurring failures, and condensed the ncp AGENTS.md conventions.
decisions: Sample set limited to 7 files: ncp gizmo 0109–0115 (current session 01a0b007), cronkis gizmo 0080, and ncp agent-journal 0027 — chosen to span active Unity session, cross-project comparison, and an older prompt-quality baseline.

Characterized ncp recent prompting as strong (terse directives, specific Unity MCP commands like `unity command build --dry_run`, `editor_status`, `get_console_logs`, `list_build_profiles`) and cronkis sample as weak ("commit everything now"), per sampled content.
Reported that .pi/skills/unity-docs and writing-for-agents exist on disk but are not referenced in sampled tool calls; work uses raw bash/powershell/write/edit plus `unity command *`.

Reported that sampled transcripts show almost no in-transcript model discussion (grep of all ncp gizmo journals: `codex`×8, `gpt-5`×2; no opus/sonnet/gemini hits), so sessions are tool-execution logs rather than model comparisons.

Categorized recurring ncp gizmo failures as: (1) Unity headless build blocked by modal confirm dialog, (2) shader-variant explosion / CPU meltdown with non-Unity culprits (CymaticsHub, MsMpEng, syncthing), (3) hallucinated tools `unity_wait_for_compile`, `unity_test` recovered via `editor_status`/`run_tests`, (4) `git status --cached` invalid flag and `git_status maxBuffer exceeded` on large repos, (5) missing `Builds/Demo/` and `run_tests --filter` invalid arg.
errors: `ls` failures for missing ncp subpaths: .agent, output, outputs (none exist on disk).
`ls Builds`, `ls -d build* Build*` in ncp returned 'No such file or directory' — no build output directory exists.

Transcript-recorded tool failures (per sampled content): `unity_wait_for_compile` and `unity_test` returned 'not found'; `git status --cached` rejected as invalid flag; `git_status maxBuffer exceeded` on large untracked-asset repos; `run_tests --filter` rejected as 'Invalid arg'.
